entries.title: Genesis 46:1
segments: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 46:2
segments: And God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob! And he said, Here I [am].

entries.title: Genesis 46:3
segments: And He said, I [am] God, the God of your fathers. Do not fear to go down into Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation.

entries.title: Genesis 46:4
segments: I will go down with you into Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up again. And Joseph shall put his hand on your eyes.

entries.title: Genesis 46:5
segments: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba. And the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

entries.title: Genesis 46:6
segments: And they took their cattle, and their goods which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

entries.title: Genesis 46:7
segments: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed, he brought with him into Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 46:8
segments: And these [were] the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's first-born.

entries.title: Genesis 46:9
segments: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

entries.title: Genesis 46:10
segments: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 46:11
segments: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

entries.title: Genesis 46:12
segments: And the sons of Judah: Er and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah. But Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez: Hezron and Hamul.

entries.title: Genesis 46:13
segments: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

entries.title: Genesis 46:14
segments: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Elon and Jahleel.

entries.title: Genesis 46:15
segments: These [were] the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

entries.title: Genesis 46:16
segments: And the sons of Gad [were] Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

entries.title: Genesis 46:17
segments: And the sons of Asher: Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and their sister Serah. And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

entries.title: Genesis 46:18
segments: These [are] the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these whom she bore to Jacob, sixteen souls.

entries.title: Genesis 46:19
segments: The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 46:20
segments: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath the daughter of Potipherah the priest of On bore him.

entries.title: Genesis 46:21
segments: And the sons of Benjamin: Belah and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

entries.title: Genesis 46:22
segments: These [are] the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob. All the souls [were] fourteen.

entries.title: Genesis 46:23
segments: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.

entries.title: Genesis 46:24
segments: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

entries.title: Genesis 46:25
segments: These [were] the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob. All the souls [were] seven.

entries.title: Genesis 46:26
segments: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, who came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls [were] sixty-six.

entries.title: Genesis 46:27
segments: And the sons of Joseph, who [were] born to him in Egypt, [were] two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, [were] seventy.

entries.title: Genesis 46:28
segments: And he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to direct his face to Goshen.

entries.title: Genesis 46:29
segments: And Joseph made his chariot ready, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself to him. And he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

entries.title: Genesis 46:30
segments: And Israel said to Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you [are] still alive.

entries.title: Genesis 46:31
segments: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's house, I will go up and show Pharaoh, and say to him, My brothers and my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

entries.title: Genesis 46:32
segments: And the men [are] shepherds, for they have been men of cattle. And they have brought their flocks and their herds and all that they have.

entries.title: Genesis 46:33
segments: And it shall be when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What [is] your occupation?

entries.title: Genesis 46:34
segments: Then you shall say, Your servants have been men of cattle from our youth even until now, both we and our fathers, so that you may live in the land of Goshen, for every shepherd [is] an abomination to the Egyptians.
